crossRefs.note: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to Yahweh your God’s…
If the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to put his name is too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd…
Even as the gazelle and as the deer is eaten, so you shall eat of it. The unclean and the clean may eat of it alike.

translations.web: You shall eat it within your gates. The unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle and as the deer.
translations.bsb: Eat it within your gates; both the ceremonially unclean and clean may eat it as they would a gazelle or a deer.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates: the unclean and the clean person shall eat it alike, as the roebuck, and as the hart.
translations.asv: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates: the unclean and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle, and as the hart.
